integration_ai.ask.title: Ask your till
integration_ai.ask.hint: Ask about sales, stock or till activity in plain words.
integration_ai.ask.question: Your question — e.g. What sold best this week?
integration_ai.ask.confirm_hint: Check the change below. Nothing changes until you press Confirm.
integration_ai.ask.error: The assistant could not answer right now — check that the AI server is running and try again.
integration_ai.ask.question_invalid: Type a question of up to 500 characters.
integration_ai.ask.unavailable: Ask your till is not available with the current AI Assistant settings.
integration_ai.identify.not_configured: Identify by camera is not set up yet: enter your AI server address or API key in the AI Assistant plugin's settings.
integration_ai.identify.bad_photo: The photo must be a JPEG or PNG of at most 4 MB.
integration_ai.error.key_rejected: Your AI provider rejected the API key. Check the key in the AI Assistant plugin's settings.
integration_ai.error.no_credit: Your AI provider account has no credit left. Add credit or a payment plan in your account with the provider, then try again.
integration_ai.error.rate_limited: Your AI provider is busy or limiting requests right now. Try again in a minute.
integration_ai.error.unreachable: The till can't reach your AI provider. Check the internet connection and try again.
integration_ai.error.provider_failed: Your AI provider couldn't answer right now. Try again later; if it keeps happening, check the model names in the AI Assistant plugin's settings and your account with the provider.
integration_ai.settings.provider.help: Where the AI runs. On your own network keeps everything on your own hardware; ChatGPT and Claude use your own account with that company, at your own cost.
integration_ai.settings.provider.openai_: My own OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp)
integration_ai.settings.endpoint.help: The web address of your own AI server, for example http://192.168.1.20:11434.
integration_ai.settings.model.help: Type the model name exactly as your provider lists it.
integration_ai.settings.api_key.help: Create a key in your account with the provider and paste it here. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
